invariants.statement: Public claims do not exceed actual package source or retained evidence.
Constructed, packaged, installed, discoverable, invoked, healthy, approved, and published remain distinct.
All three visual roles use different exact files, compositions, and aspect ratios; the social card visibly names Signal Loom.
Publication remains manual and no unavailable hosted workflow is triggered.
A PASS cannot be issued before exact candidate deployment and live re-verification.

risks.statement: If documentation outruns product source, customers may rely on nonexistent or unsafe behavior.
If installation prose collapses file presence into activation, customers may believe an inert package is healthy.
If local navigation or assets are broken, the Pages journey may strand visitors.
If visual roles are duplicated, generic, or illegible, the repository fails product presentation requirements.
If privacy, network, or security claims are false, users may expose sensitive sources.
If package lifecycle behavior regresses, documented initialization, validation, and packaging paths may fail.
Publishing the candidate would trigger unavailable GitHub-hosted workflows and cannot satisfy the required status check without provider execution or explicit control change.
Until deployment, the live repository and Pages remain on pre-remediation bytes and cannot pass exact live verification.
If packaging refuses an existing output only after validation, the failed operation may mutate the Loomfile release manifest.
If essential installation labels or navigation fail source-level accessibility checks, readers may be unable to choose or follow the correct host route.
If archive writing or final linking fails or is interrupted, a partial final archive may escape, project state may mutate, competing output may be overwritten, or retry may be blocked.
If manifest hashes are computed from bytes other than the exact archived payload stream, concurrent source mutation may produce a successful archive with false release evidence.
If required empty Loomfile directories are omitted from the ZIP, a fresh project may package successfully but fail validation after extraction.
If only mutable source state is validated before writing, a registered source may change and yield an archive whose own source-manifest contract is invalid.
If the requested archive resolves inside the Loomfile, packaging mutates the project despite the single-artifact and project-immutability contract.
If the declared Python minimum is older than syntax accepted by the shipped scripts, customers may follow valid instructions into an immediate syntax failure.
If canonical faculty table-of-contents fragments do not resolve, progressive loading becomes unnecessarily difficult and the long reference accumulates avoidable cognitive-load friction.

findings.statement: Required line-ending-policy status depends on GitHub-hosted Actions whose capacity is unavailable; no workflow may be triggered to discover capacity.
Live Pages still serves the pre-remediation site and old generic hero; final assets and custom 404 are absent until publication.
The original single particle-wave image was generic, textless, and reused as every visual role.
The original Pages documentation omitted installation, verification, lifecycle, recovery, and support guidance.
The original narrow-screen CSS hid all navigation except Help.
The first candidate refused overwrite only after validation regenerated review/release-manifest.json, mutating state on a failed operation.
findings.status: repaired; regression proves ZIP and manifest immutability

findings.statement: Accessibility review found failing light-surface contrast and narrow-screen reflow, then found 12px install-host labels at 2.95:1.
findings.status: repaired; final independent review passes at exact candidate

findings.statement: The bbef398 candidate wrote the release manifest before ZIP completion and wrote directly to the final output, so injected mid-write failure mutated evidence, left a partial ZIP, and blocked retry.
findings.status: repaired; five direct regressions prove guarded commit, rollback, cleanup, competing-output preservation, archive/manifest identity, and retry

findings.statement: Two composite PowerShell lifecycle transcript wrappers failed in their own expected-stderr/capture plumbing and were abandoned after the second failure.
findings.status: closed; no product evidence claimed from wrappers; plain direct unittest execution retained

findings.statement: The 92f4773 candidate precomputed hashes before archive writes, so concurrent source mutation could yield a successful archive whose payload disagreed with its manifest.
findings.status: repaired; hashes and byte counts now derive from the exact stream written and every archived payload is checked in regression

findings.statement: The 92f4773 two-artifact design could advance the project manifest and roll back the ZIP if interrupted immediately after manifest replacement.
findings.status: repaired by eliminating project mutation; the ZIP is the only committed artifact and post-link interruption is covered

findings.statement: The 17ed4f3 candidate could leave the final ZIP behind if os.link created it and then raised before the ownership flag assignment.
findings.status: repaired; file-identity cleanup and exact link-then-raise regression pass

findings.statement: The 17ed4f3 candidate omitted required empty Loomfile directories, so a fresh ZIP failed validation after extraction.
findings.status: repaired; explicit directory entries and fresh extracted-root regression pass

findings.statement: The 17ed4f3 candidate could accept a registered source changed after pre-validation even though the extracted archive violated its own source-manifest hash.
findings.status: repaired; exact archived state is extracted and validated before exposure; mutation regression is rejected cleanly

findings.statement: The 17ed4f3 candidate accepted an output path inside the Loomfile and changed the project tree.
findings.status: repaired; resolved containment is rejected before side effects and complete project snapshot remains identical

findings.statement: Public documentation and manifest declared Python 3.9+ although shipped PEP 604 union syntax requires Python 3.10+.
findings.status: repaired; manifest, README, customer guide, and Pages consistently declare Python 3.10+

findings.statement: Three canonical faculty table-of-contents links targeted nonexistent fragments for Viralizer, Toysmith, and Diagnostic Reviewer.
findings.status: repaired; exact three-link delta and independent targeted accessibility re-review resolve all nine routes

GitHub branch rules require line-ending-policy, Pages uses workflow deployment, and the owner reports GitHub-hosted Actions capacity exhausted; no workflow may be triggered merely to discover capacity. Local policy success cannot create the required GitHub status context.
Current remote main and live Pages are pre-remediation, so repository PASS is forbidden until publication and exact live re-verification.

After publication: exact remote commit, rendered Pages, navigation, custom 404, README hero, Pages hero, social card, metadata, and asset hashes must be rechecked live.
